steps: Whisk Greek yogurt with sweetener until smooth
Fold in cream to adjust richness and texture
Stir manually every hour to break ice crystals
Transfer to mixer for final aeration before serving
Chop fresh fruit into bite-sized pieces
Spoon yogurt into cups and layer toppings

swaps.why: Shop lacks soft-serve equipment; manual churning mimics texture
Easier to source and serve in a café setting

hooks: Fresh fruit on soft frozen yogurt
Korean style dessert in a cup
plan.caption: Try our new Korean yogurt ice cream. Thick Greek yogurt churned smooth, topped with sweet honeycomb shards and fresh fruit. A refreshing treat for your afternoon. #dessert #singaporefood
plan.offer: Buy any dessert, get half-price yogurt ice cream
